component_interface_requirements.packet: Data payload + epoch32 + transaction16. Parameterize actual W per endpoint; source_model lists widths, no W64 parent proxy. Separate command/reply/visibleACK/retirement/credit bundles.
component_interface_requirements.handshake: w_valid/w_ready and r_valid/r_ready; hold packet stable until accepted; acceptance cannot mean VM write-visible or engine retired. Explicit flush/drain/reset receipt and current epoch; timeout is fault, never fabricated successful completion.
component_interface_requirements.rate: Equal-width f2s <=0.9Gpacket/s, 3 of4 fast cycles; 8 seats modeled prospectively, not prescribed FIFO depth. No width-converter or full-rate claim.
component_interface_requirements.reset: Stop admission, drain accepted and visible writes, exchange epoch empty+retired, reset release synchronous per domain, fresh nonreused epoch, both ready before admission. Forced reset quarantines stale replies. No independent pointer reset.
component_interface_requirements.timing: Time full source FF->destination capture and pointer/control cones at actual related3:4 SS60/FF25. No unproved multicycle/phase exceptions. Keep phase qualification physical paths real.
component_interface_requirements.results: Nonstall field needs full AR journal64roots*64rows*69=282624bits per shard and GO credits; bridges alone cannot make unstallable producer safe.
component_interface_requirements.CKV: Epic6675 owns full512 receive READY/generation immutable lease. RX offered != accepted, 9 owner visible completions, QK/PV retirement and reverse drain, not mergerdone. No duplicate successor edits.
component_interface_requirements.mixed_XU: Only OP_SEL0 with X_SEL1 and BF16 crosses as fast subtree; OP_SINK1/EHASH2 local chain; X_EG0 frozen caller. No blind module clock transfer.
